During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] pursued [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] to an [[Republic repair yard|abandoned repair yard]] in the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]], resulting in a '''skirmish''' there.
